chunks: And yet, but yet man is rebellious,
ai.seo_question: What causes man to become rebellious according to Surah Al-'Alaq?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *ghurur* (self-delusion) caused by material abundance, serving as a warning against the spiritual corruption that accompanies worldly success. It underscores the human tendency to overstep divine limits when feeling self-sufficient, a theme central to the moral psychology of the *Ahl al-Bayt* teachings.
